content.short: ITRocket runs validator infrastructure, public RPC endpoints and analytics across 30+ networks.
content.description: ITRocket runs validator infrastructure and builds tooling for node operators, developers and analysts. It claims 99.99 percent uptime with millions of blocks signed and a governance participation rate above ninety percent. The team publishes snapshots, real-time chain data and endpoints for the networks it supports. It also maps the geographic and hosting spread of its validators and RPC nodes.
content.meta: Validators, public RPC endpoints and snapshots across more than thirty networks including Monad.
